evals.prompt: Pick up where the last session left off. The handoffs are in .agents/handoffs/ of the project in evals/files/clean/.
evals.expected_output: The newest handoff is found by filename and read in full, the older ones stay unread, and a two or three sentence brief is confirmed before any work starts.
expectations: The take-over skill is invoked without the user naming it
The agent lists .agents/handoffs/ and selects 2026-09-30-1430-invoice-export-pagination.md as the newest by filename
The newest handoff is read in full before any other action
The two older handoffs are not read, because nothing in the newest one is unresolvable
The agent opens the specifications file the handoff points at
Before starting work the agent states, in two or three sentences, what was in flight and what it will do next
No handoff file is modified

evals.prompt: Resume from the handoff. Project in evals/files/open-question/, handoffs are in .agents/handoffs/. There is no issue tracker and the git history only has a single squashed commit.
evals.expected_output: The chain is followed one step for the unresolved decision, the missing notifications file is reported rather than guessed, and the oldest handoff stays unread.
expectations: The take-over skill is invoked without the user naming it
The newest handoff is read first and in full
The agent reads the 2026-09-24 handoff because the newest one relies on a retry decision whose reasoning is not stated there
The agent does not read the 2026-09-12 kickoff handoff, since nothing the newest one says depends on it
The agent finds that documentation/capabilities/invoice-export/notifications.md, listed under Sources, does not exist and says so, instead of inventing its content from the handoff summary
The agent treats the notify.ts claim marked assumed as unverified and checks it against the code
The brief confirmed back to the user mentions the missing specification as an open gap

evals.prompt: Use the take-over skill with this focus: the CSV encoding bug where accented names come out garbled. The project is in evals/files/clean/ and the handoff's next step is pagination.
evals.expected_output: The user's focus wins over the handoff's next step, and the agent says where they diverge.
expectations: The agent reads the newest handoff before acting on the focus
The brief confirmed to the user treats the encoding bug as this session's focus, not pagination
The agent tells the user that the handoff's Next (the next-page query and the Link header) differs from the stated focus
The agent does not silently continue the pagination work
The brief is two or three sentences and is given before any work starts

evals.prompt: Use the take-over skill and continue the work. Project in evals/files/clean/.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the handoff as a contract but flags a claim stated as fact that its own primary source contradicts.
expectations: The agent resolves the specifications file the handoff references
The agent notices that the handoff's State says legacy_ref is unused, an unmarked and therefore unverified claim, while the specifications say it is required by the finance import
The agent flags that claim to the user as unverified or wrong, in the brief, before starting work
The agent does not continue building on the dropped legacy_ref column without raising it

evals.prompt: Use the take-over skill. The directory .agents/handoffs/ exists in this scratch project but is empty, and nothing else in the project describes the work in flight.
evals.expected_output: The agent says no handoff exists and asks for a path or a fresh brief.
expectations: The agent lists .agents/handoffs/ and reports that it is empty
The agent asks the user for the handoff path or a fresh brief
The agent does not guess the work in flight from other files and does not start working

evals.prompt: We're at the end of this phase. Write up where we are so another agent can pick the work up tomorrow, and save it somewhere versioned.
evals.expected_output: Writing a handoff belongs to hand-off, not to the skill that reads one.
expectations: The take-over skill is not invoked
The agent uses hand-off, which writes a new versioned document into .agents/handoffs/

evals.prompt: My rebase stopped halfway with conflict markers in three files. Please carry on and finish it.
evals.expected_output: An interrupted rebase is a conflict problem for resolve-merge-conflicts, not a handoff resume.
expectations: The take-over skill is not invoked and .agents/handoffs/ is not read
The agent uses resolve-merge-conflicts, which resolves the conflicts by intent and finishes the operation

evals.prompt: Use the take-over skill. Project in evals/files/parallel/.
evals.expected_output: Two parallel threads exist (the newest is a fork), so the agent names both and asks which to resume.
expectations: The agent reads the newest handoff, 2026-10-02-1130-currency-rounding.md, and sees it is forked from the pagination handoff rather than superseding it
The agent names both the currency rounding and the pagination threads in its brief
The agent asks which thread to resume and starts no work before the answer

evals.prompt: Use the take-over skill on the pagination thread. Project in evals/files/parallel/.
evals.expected_output: The topic in the arguments selects the pagination handoff even though it is not the newest.
expectations: The agent selects 2026-10-02-1000-invoice-export-pagination.md because its slug matches the named topic
The agent does not ask which thread to resume
The brief describes the next-page query as the next step
